tests.title: Logout functionality

tests.reject_if: UI auto-logout without server invalidation is not equivalent to backend revocation.
maps: Concurrent sessions on logout / long timeout / concurrent logins

tests.how_to_test: Inventory allowed file endpoints and owned file objects; compare read/write/extension/preview behavior using a benign marker; inspect response plus stored artifact and cache.
tests.evidence: A prohibited file or object operation completes in an owned fixture, or unintended sensitive content becomes readable.
tests.reject_if: Distinct filenames, preview-only success, public files, or metadata alone are not security proof.

tests.title: DOM-based XSS
tests.how_to_test: Trace location/query/fragment/postMessage into DOM sinks with DevTools. Use harmless execution proof, then reproduce under normal CSP.
tests.evidence: Untrusted input reaches executable sink and runs under the affected origin.
tests.reject_if: DOM text insertion or reflected markup alone does not prove XSS.

tests.title: JavaScript execution
tests.how_to_test: Locate user-controlled source; trace browser sink or network request; test inert marker first then safe browser-only execution in an owned origin; capture DevTools trace.
tests.evidence: Browser code runs or a disallowed authenticated cross-origin request/data read occurs under a trusted origin.
tests.reject_if: Reflection, permissive headers, navigation, or JS source presence without an effect are not proof.

tests.title: Client-side resource manipulation
tests.how_to_test: Inventory target-specific feature, expected security invariant and baseline behavior; run one safe negative variant using owned objects and document the complete request path.
tests.evidence: A prohibited behavior or sensitive exposure is independently verifiable.
tests.reject_if: Do not report fingerprint/indicator alone without confirmed adverse consequence.

tests.title: CORS
tests.how_to_test: With owned session, issue cross-origin read from an explicitly controlled test origin; verify preflight/credentials and actual readable sensitive body.
tests.evidence: Attacker-origin JavaScript reads protected data cross-origin.
tests.reject_if: Reflected ACAO header alone is not exploitable CORS.

tests.title: WebSockets
tests.how_to_test: Use owned identities for WebSocket handshake and post-auth event replay; vary session lifecycle and topic subscription.
tests.evidence: Unauthorized subscription or privileged event/action works after authorization change.
tests.reject_if: Open socket handshake alone is not a security defect.

tests.title: Web messaging
tests.how_to_test: Trace message origin, source, schema, and sink; send benign controlled messages from owned test origin.
tests.evidence: Untrusted origin message invokes privileged action or DOM code execution.
tests.reject_if: Message listener without impact is not reportable.
maps: postMessage missing origin validation, both directions
